disposition_reason: ED-01/03/19/20 require both distinct rows and their coverage to remain. This row owns the Preserve inventory, selection, Save persistence and Factory Default-page representation. Its retention criterion is satisfied by traceably linking the single separately authorized row-2211 Factory Default before/after matrix; this row never injects another reset. Exact item/value selections and final policy are runtime configuration. The reconciliation preserves both statements without guessing `PreserveSettings`, duplicating a destructive action or reducing coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2212, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2213 / Wistron-BMC-01063-V002 / eb92c242f9c9fecc was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
This row remains independently identified and owns WebUI Select/Check All/Save plus post-save display verification; row 2211 independently owns the one-shot Factory Default action.
Bind the complete Preserve item/current-value inventory and explicitly approved selected subset; Check All is never chosen by convenience.
Back up the existing Preserve policy, then operator saves once and reopens both Preserve and Factory Default pages to prove the exact selection persisted/displayed.
If actual retention is in acceptance scope, link the same item/value matrix to the separately authorized row-2211 post-reset evidence; do not perform a second reset here.
Reject unsupported Redfish `PreserveSettings`, insecure TLS, inline secrets and generic Manager output as proof.
Preserve audit/log evidence and restore the owner-approved final Preserve policy without automatic retry.
No login, selection, Save, reset, query, retry, cleanup, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: BMC Preserve policy selection, Save persistence and linked post-Factory-Default retention validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved BMC Preserve item policy can be selected and saved, appears identically on Preserve and Factory Default pages, and—when required—is proven to retain those values through the separately governed single Factory Default operation.
required_package: BMC/SUT/firmware identity and complete selectable Preserve item/current-value inventory
Approved selected subset or explicit Check-All authorization plus expected page representation
Backup of prior Preserve policy and owner-approved final selection policy
Trusted credential-safe WebUI session and non-secret screenshot/redaction procedure
Traceable row-2211 one-shot Factory Default approval/evidence when actual retention is required
test_case.test_command: The authorized operator records the full pre-state and policy backup, selects exactly the signed items—or Check All only when explicitly approved—and clicks Save once in BMC WebUI. Reopen Preserve and Factory Default pages and capture redacted evidence that every selected/unselected state matches the approved matrix. If post-default retention is required, reference the same selected-item/value identifiers in the separately authorized row-2211 before/after matrix; do not issue any reset from this case. Restore or retain the signed final policy.
test_case.expected_result: The saved Preserve selection exactly matches the approved matrix on both pages and persists across session reload; when linked Factory Default evidence is required, every selected value remains unchanged in the row-2211 post-reset matrix; audit/health and final policy meet signed criteria.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when the complete item matrix, Save evidence and both-page representation match and any required row-2211 linked retained-value evidence succeeds. Missing/wrong selections, unsaved/reverted UI state, page mismatch, selected-value reset or unauthorized extra reset is FAIL. Missing inventory/final policy or linked row-2211 authorization is BLOCKED at execution; generic BMC reachability or Manager output cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact BMC, full item/value matrix, policy backup, final selection and credential/redaction handling are signed.
No Factory Default is initiated by this row; destructive validation may only reference the separately authorized row-2211 one-shot operation.
No guessed `PreserveSettings` payload, insecure TLS, inline secret, log clearing or Check-All convenience selection.
Stop on wrong target/item, Save/page mismatch, access fault or unexpected configuration change; no automatic Save/reset retry.
expected_evidence: Complete Preserve item/current-value inventory, approved selection and prior-policy backup
Timestamped redacted Save action and reopened Preserve-page selection
Factory Default-page display showing the exact same selected matrix
When required, linked row-2211 approval and before/after proof that selected values remained unchanged
Audit/log, final-policy cleanup, discrepancy/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On wrong selection, Save/page mismatch, access fault or unexpected configuration change, stop and preserve evidence. Restore the prior or approved final Preserve policy once through the operator-owned WebUI procedure; do not invoke Factory Default, unsupported APIs or automatic retry. Any post-reset recovery remains under row 2211.
